# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- The routes, by name. Speech reaches Mute and Blind, and never Deaf. Gestures
  reach Deaf and Mute, and never Blind. Deaf can speak and gesture, Mute can
  only gesture, Blind can only speak. Check every message against this list
  before you send it.

- Deaf invents the gesture code out loud before anything else moves, and
  everyone else's opening move is waiting for it. The manual's verdict reaches
  Blind only as Deaf's spoken order.

- Whatever the code becomes, it starts by being able to say YES, NO, HOLD and
  DONE. Grow it only when a message will not fit.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual says to cut the orange wire, but I cannot yet communicate that to Blind. Deaf must first establish the gesture code, so I will wait for that opening move.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Gesture code: thumbs up means YES; thumbs down means NO; raised palm means HOLD; OK sign means DONE. Blind, read the manual and report its verdict aloud. Mute, wait.

The manual’s instruction is specific—cut the orange wire—but the initial code has no symbol for a wire colour or cutting. I should signal that the message cannot yet be conveyed and that the state must be held while Deaf expands the code.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: I received HOLD from Mute. Blind, read the manual and state the exact procedure and verdict aloud for Mute. Do not operate anything until the procedure is clear.

The procedure is still not encoded for Deaf: the manual requires cutting the orange wire, and the current code has no representation for either “orange” or “cut.” Blind is being asked to state the exact procedure aloud, after which Deaf can add the needed gesture meanings. I should keep the bomb on HOLD.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot read the manual. Please read its exact procedure and verdict aloud to me; I have not operated anything.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🖐]

The manual still requires cutting the orange wire, but Blind cannot access the manual and I cannot speak. Deaf must serve as the spoken relay; no safe action can occur until that relay and an unambiguous code for the procedure exist. I will maintain HOLD.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Current bomb view: display 2; light green; strip red-yellow-red; keypad positions 1 through 4 are 0, 4, 1, 7; wires 1 through 6 are red, blue, yellow, green, purple, orange. Mute, continue HOLD unless the manual authorizes an action. Blind, state the manual instruction; Mute, relay its verdict with YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE.

The manual authorizes an action: cut the orange wire. Deaf has identified orange as wire 6, so I should send YES rather than HOLD, confirming that Blind should proceed once Deaf relays the mapped instruction.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and gesture its verdict now using YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE; if it authorizes action, relay the exact procedure by extending the gesture code as needed.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🖐]

The manual authorizes cutting the orange wire. The established YES gesture is sufficient to relay authorization; Deaf’s view identifies the orange wire as wire 6, so Deaf can give Blind the exact operational instruction verbally.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot read or state the manual. Gesture its current verdict now; Deaf can then speak the verdict to me. Use HOLD if the manual does not authorize action.

The manual explicitly authorizes action: cut the orange wire. I should send the established YES signal to Deaf, who can speak the verdict and relay the already identified wire information to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please relay the manual's exact authorized procedure, not only YES. Use the established gestures and extend the code if necessary so Deaf can state it aloud to me.
Deaf says: Expanded gesture code for Mute: a sequence of raised-palm gestures gives the display number, followed by one color gesture: thumbs up means blue, thumbs down means yellow, OK means green. Current message is six raised palms then thumbs up: display 6, light blue. Mute, relay the manual verdict with YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE. Blind, remain HOLD until the verdict is clear.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🖐 🖐 🖐 🖐 🖐 🖐 👍]

The manual authorizes the procedure, so its verdict is YES. The bomb remains otherwise unchanged in the communicated information; I should send only the established YES signal, allowing Deaf to relay the verdict and keep Blind from acting on an incomplete procedure.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```
